card: THE DUNES CLUB. NARRAGANSETT, RHODE ISLAND.
THE FIRST CLUBHOUSE WASHED AWAY IN 1938.
REBUILT IN 1939 BY THOMAS PYM COPE.
posts.alt_hint: A 1939 beach club room under open timber trusses, with sofas and lamps facing a curved wall of windows onto the sea.
posts.bring: BRING SOMEONE WHO SUMMERED SOMEWHERE WITH A POOL.
posts.survival_check: 2026-11-02: rooms checked against the 2015 National Register nomination (https://preservation.ri.gov/pdfs_zips_downloads/national_pdfs/narragansett/narr_boston-neck-road-137_dunes-club.pdf): club room, loggia and dining room intact (dining room has its original chairs and serving tables); barroom inside the intact core; ocean portico frame removed because the portico has since been glazed.

card: A LANDMARKED BUILDING ON DEKALB AVENUE.
A BRECCIA PERNICE STONE WINE BAR.
posts.alt_hint: A wood-panelled listening bar with a long red-brown stone counter, steel stools and a big speaker set into the shelving.

card: SKYWALKER GRILL. EXPOSITION PARK, LOS ANGELES.
ON TOP OF THE LUCAS MUSEUM. OPENED SEPTEMBER 2026.
CHERRY WOOD ON THE WALLS AND THE CEILING.
NO TWO PANELS ALIKE. A BAR CLAD IN SILVER GILT.
A TERRACE LOOKING OUT OVER DOWNTOWN.
posts.alt_hint: A curving restaurant wrapped in cherry wood, with pale leaf-patterned chairs around a sculptural bar under a glowing oval ceiling.
posts.facts_from: Card facts: lucasmuseum.org/press/skywalker-grill-announcement (opening 22 September 2026, cherry wood walls and ceiling, terrace) and the Wallpaper review (no two panels alike, bar clad in silver gilt, views over downtown). The Dezeen article text did not come through the harvest.

posts.credit: Carol M. Highsmith Archive, Library of Congress
card: THE GREENBRIER. WHITE SULPHUR SPRINGS, WEST VIRGINIA.
DOROTHY DRAPER REDECORATED IT AFTER THE WAR.
HER FIRM HAS STYLED IT FOR OVER 75 YEARS.
posts.alt_hint: A grand hotel sitting room with mint green walls, a gilded eagle over a white fireplace and floral sofas around a low white table.
posts.survival_check: 2026-11-09: greenbrier.com is taking bookings (Thanksgiving and Christmas 2026 offers), describes the indoor pool as open year-round and says Dorothy Draper & Company has styled the resort for over 75 years; Galerie (2020, updated October 2026) quotes Carleton Varney that the lobby sofas have never changed. Frames: lobby sitting room (item 2015634492), hallway (2015634493), indoor pool (2015634486), circular gathering room (2015634491), entrance front (2015634494). The room-by-room evidence is the resort's own account, not a register nomination; photographed in 2015 under the current owner and decorator.
